messages:
Tara - MKTG: Need a tight deliverable for next week's launch rehearsal: landing hero, webinar slide with sparkline, inbound-routing diagram for ops, and three microtiles (cost/latency/quality). First drafts by Tue noon.

Eli (Design): Copy locked? Also which hero crop first, desktop or mobile?

Tara - MKTG: Locking desktop hero first (we'll crop to mobile/social). Headline: 'Serving Wins: predictable, economical inference.' Two bullets: 'Latency SLOs across deployments' and 'Cost controls via batching & quantization'.

Jun - Creative Ops: Uploaded starter Figma kit: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/servekit. Component set: kit/micro-v3. Added localization keys (EN/FR/DE) and export tokens.

Eli (Design): Will do hybrid schematic/illustrative hero. Draft export spec: hero 1400x800 (svg/png), microtile 600x600 (svg/png), slide 1920x1080 (pptx/png), routing 1100x800 (svg).

Sana - Brand: Use stacked logo mark. No effects on logos. Palette: /brand/palettes/visual.csv. Ensure text contrast >=4.5:1. Sparkline: SVG for slide; short MP4 for social.

Omar PMM: Microtiles: dev (tokens/sec + latency), enterprise (SLA + private deploy callout), finance (cost/unit + batching note). I'll drop 1-line copy by 3pm.

Figma Bot: Component "kit/micro-v3" updated by Eli (Design) at 2026-03-26T18:02:10Z.

Jun - Creative Ops: I'll run accessibility checks and prepare handoff bundle (pngs, svgs, alt_text.md, export_manifest.csv) once frames are ready. Name pattern: rdw_launchkit_<asset>_<audience>_v1.

Tara - MKTG: Please ping #marketing-ops when first pass is in Figma. Slide PNG needed before Wed rehearsal. Thanks! :rocket:
